answer: Mechanism: each agent commits a cipher of a unique hardware secret, then reveals it to mint one sealed ticket per epoch. Tickets are painted onto a shared pigment ledger whose color density is capped, so a sudden plume of look-alike identities must overlap and gets rejected. The attacker must own a distinct physical device and solve a fresh puzzle for every fake agent, so cost scales with real hardware and energy per identity, not with cheap keypairs.
